mapper.sql: FROM community_chief c LEFT JOIN community_chief_distributor d ON c.chief_id = d.chief_id LEFT JOIN community_chief_apply_info a ON c.user_id = a.user_id AND d.distributor_id = a.distributor_id
mapper.select:
SELECT c.chief_id, c.company_id, c.chief_name, c.chief_avatar, c.chief_mobile, c.chief_desc, c.chief_intro, c.province, c.city, c.area, c.regions_id, c.regions, c.address, c.lng, c.lat, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.alipay_name, c.alipay_account, c.bank_name, c.bankcard_no, a.created_at AS apply_time, d.bound_time AS approve_time, d.distributor_id, (CASE WHEN a.apply_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS source, a.extra_data
ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT c.chief_id, c.company_id, c.chief_name, c.chief_avatar, c.chief_mobile, c.chief_desc, c.chief_intro, c.province, c.city, c.area, c.regions_id, c.regions, c.address, c.lng, c.lat, c.user_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, c.alipay_name, c.alipay_account, c.bank_name, c.bankcard_no, a.created_at AS apply_time, d.bound_time AS approve_time, d.distributor_id, (CASE WHEN a.apply_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS source, a.extra_data
WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND CAST(c.chief_id AS CHAR) = #{chiefId} AND d.distributor_id = #{distributorId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC, c.chief_id DESC LIMIT 1
